outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic (BioRender) illustrating the experimental workflow; it is not a plot of data, so the check does not apply.
Bar chart of Tmprss11b qRT-PCR expression (mean ± SD) with individual data points (dots) overlaid for each replicate in all three groups.
Tumor volume is shown as a scatter/dot plot with mean and 95% CI; individual mouse data points are plotted for each group.
Bar chart of Tmprss11b qRT-PCR expression (mean ± SD) with individual data points overlaid for each replicate in all three groups.
This is a line plot of tumor volume over time (mean ± SEM per timepoint across groups); line plots are exempt from the individual data point requirement as overlaying points would make it unreadable.
Panel F contains a fluorescent micrograph plus a bar chart (mean ± SD) quantifying CD4 intensity; individual data points (dots) for each field are overlaid on the bars.
Panel G contains a fluorescent micrograph plus a bar chart (mean ± SD) quantifying pERK intensity; individual data points (dots) for each field are overlaid on the bars.
